pages.text: She flies. Her $(thing)sting dive$() leaves her dazed on the floor for a moment: that's your opening. She sprays wax in a fan, lays cocoons that are nearly ripe, and buffets you with her wings if you stand under her.
pages.title: Waxen Queen

pages.text: Hive bugs defend her and Nursemaids heal her, so kill the Nursemaids first. When angry she calls Stingers.
4 $(item)Royal Honey Drops$() and 2 $(item)Crystallized Wings$(), always. They make the $(l:gear/weapons)Royal Grandhammer$(/l) and the $(l:gear/armour)Crystallized Honey$(/l) armour.
pages.title: Drops
